learning_objective: The learner will critique six iframe snippets by naming the problem in each or judging it fine, with at least 5 of 6 correct on the first attempt.
specification:
Type: microsim **sim-id:** iframe-snippet-reviewer
**Library:** p5.js
**Status:** Specified
**Bloom Level:** Evaluate
**Bloom Verb:** critique
**Learning Objective:** The learner will critique six iframe snippets by naming the problem in each or judging it fine, with at least 5 of 6 correct on the first attempt. **Prerequisites:** Embeddable Component, Standalone Component (both defined in this chapter above this block). **Evidence of Mastery:** For each snippet the learner chooses one of four verdicts. A choice is correct when it matches the Correct verdict column in Content. Mastery is at least 5 of 6 correct on the first attempt. Reading the attribute list is exploration, not evidence. **Misconceptions:** (1) A relative address works anywhere. (2) A fixed width is harmless. (3) The title attribute is optional. **Instructional Rationale:** Critiquing a snippet against a short list of requirements is an Evaluate-level action that a reviewer performs when testing portability. Six snippets, each with at most one defect, isolate the requirements. **Content:** The requirements, shown on request: the address must be complete and public; the frame must fit any page; the frame must have a title; the page must open with no login. The four verdicts: Fine, Fix the address, Make the width flexible, Add a title. The six snippets (all with example addresses): | # | Snippet shown to the learner | Correct verdict | Why (shown as feedback) | |---|---|---|---| | 1 | iframe with src "https://example.org/sims/runoff/main.html", width "100%", height "500", title "Runoff simulation" | Fine | It has a complete address, a flexible width, and a title. | | 2 | iframe with src "main.html", width "100%", height "500", title "Runoff simulation" | Fix the address | A relative address points to a file that exists only beside the original page. | | 3 | iframe with src "https://example.org/sims/runoff/main.html", width "1200", height "500", title "Runoff simulation" | Make the width flexible | A fixed width of 1200 overflows a narrow page. | | 4 | iframe with src "https://example.org/sims/runoff/main.html", width "100%", height "500" and no title | Add a title | A screen reader cannot name the frame. | | 5 | iframe with src "https://example.org/sims/pendulum/main.html", width "100%", height "450", title "Pendulum simulation" | Fine | It has a complete address, a flexible width, and a title. | | 6 | iframe with src "file:///Users/teacher/sims/runoff/main.html", width "100%", height "500", title "Runoff simulation" | Fix the address | The address points to a file on one person's computer, which no one else can open. | **Provenance:** The snippets are illustrative cases written for this chapter, and the sim labels them "illustrative examples". The requirements follow the chapter section "Embeddable Component". The addresses use the reserved example.org domain. **Rules:** Each snippet has exactly one correct verdict. Two snippets are Fine, two are Fix the address, one is Make the width flexible, and one is Add a title. **Learner Activity:** 1. The learner sees one snippet and the four verdicts. 2. The learner may open the requirements. Opening them does not change the score. 3. The learner chooses a verdict, and the choice is committed. 4. The sim shows whether it was correct and the Why text. 5. After snippet 6 the sim shows the summary. **Feedback:** 6 snippets in a shuffled order, one attempt each. Correct: "Correct: [verdict]. [Why]". Incorrect: "Not quite. The verdict is [verdict]. [Why]". The summary shows "[n] of 6 correct on the first attempt". At 5 or more it adds "You can read embed code." Below 5 it lists the Why text of each missed snippet. **Starting State:** The first snippet and the four verdicts. The question shown is "What, if anything, needs fixing?" **Chapter Anchors:** The chapter's iframe example uses the attributes src, width, height, and title, and says a relative address, a fixed width, and a missing title are problems.
